spells.name: Cinder Challenge
spells.timing_window: Own poker action, immediately before a legal raise; cast+raise atomic
spells.effect: On successful legal raise, mark that raise once. If at least one opponent calls that raise and caster later wins a contested pot including that caller at showdown, grant +2 Aether. If instead all opponents immediately fold to the raise, grant +1 Aether. No reward on tie, later uncontested win, caster fold or caster loss. Normal showdown regeneration resolves first; all capped at 3.
spells.exhaust_or_discard: Discard at hand end; marker expires after hand; exactly one resolution

spells.name: Unmask
spells.timing_window: Own decision, any street after hole cards dealt and before own poker action
spells.target: One active opposing seat with two hole cards
spells.public_tell_text: A violet eye opens above the chosen rival.
spells.effect: Uniformly choose one of target two hole cards and reveal its identity privately only to caster; public observers see target and cast but not card. Hidden info persists to caster for this hand only.

spells.name: Briar Lock
spells.timing_window: Street opening magic window (preflop after blinds / postflop before first betting action)
spells.public_tell_text: Thorns bind the stakes. Pot-limit this street.
spells.effect: For the current street only, every legal bet/raise, including all-in attempts, is restricted by standard pot-limit maximum computed from current pot, outstanding bet and call amount. Existing contributions, including blinds, are unchanged. Rejected if street already locked or terminal with no betting.
spells.exhaust_or_discard: Discard at hand end; modifier expires at street end

spells.name: Fate Exchange
spells.timing_window: Preflop opening magic window, after hole cards dealt and blinds posted, before first voluntary bet
spells.target: Exactly one of caster’s hole cards
spells.public_tell_text: A mirrored card turns face-down in the Wagerer’s hand.
spells.effect: Choose 1 own hole card. Draw a uniformly random replacement from undealt poker deck; only after drawing, return discarded card to undealt pool and shuffle. Never touch board, burn or other hole cards. The identity of old/new card is private to caster.
